part_a.evaluation: 5-fold CV by student; difficulty recomputed per fold from training students
part_a.fitting: fast EM, best of 5 random starts, seed 42, |dLL| <= 0.005, at most 100 iterations

design.question: Are the engine's probabilities trustworthy, and do fitted guess/slip numbers make them more trustworthy?

H1.evidence: assist09: Brier fitted 0.1948 vs heuristic 0.2252, ECE 0.0086 vs 0.1324; ct: Brier fitted 0.2069 vs heuristic 0.2452, ECE 0.0112 vs 0.1452
H1.rule: pooled out-of-fold Brier and ECE both lower, on both datasets

H2.rule: paired next-answer Brier difference with CI entirely below 0 on every curriculum

H3.evidence: fitted_assist09: mean questions difference vs heuristic over 24 cells +0.4822; fitted_ct: mean questions difference vs heuristic over 24 cells +1.3017
H3.rule: average over all Part B cells of the paired questions difference >= 0, per fitted profile

S0-S4.evidence: descriptive (no direction predicted); see the S0-S4 cells' contrasts
